cases.text: I'm so sorry to bother you, I was just wondering if there might perhaps be any chance of an extension on the essay because I've been unwell this week, no worries if not.
Hi, sorry, I know you're really busy, but I just wanted to ask whether it would be okay if I worked from home on Friday, I completely understand if this isn't possible at all.
Sorry for the trouble, I think I might have been charged twice for my order and I was wondering if you could maybe look into it when you get a chance.
I'm really sorry, I just wanted to say I can't make it to the meeting tomorrow, I hope this is okay.
Apologies for the late reply, I was just wondering if the rent could be paid a few days late this month, if that's okay.
I might be wrong but I think the boiler isn't working properly, sorry to bother you, could someone have a look?
This might be a silly question but could you explain the assignment brief again, sorry.
I'm so sorry, I just wanted to ask if I could swap my shift on Saturday with someone, I know it's short notice.
Sorry to bother you, I was wondering whether you'd be able to send me the slides from today's lecture.
I'm really sorry to ask, but would it be possible to have the meeting notes in writing, it helps me a lot.
Hi, I hope this is okay, I just wanted to let you know I'll be about ten minutes late today, sorry.
I'm sorry, I know this is annoying, but could you turn the music down a bit after eleven?
